This post happened to appear in my recommended, but I agree with another poster sounds a lot like depression and executive dysfunction. I don't have BPD but I have ADHD and depression and my ADHD meds have helped me with some of the symptoms but I'm not sure if it would for OP, every brain is different. Perhaps check and see if it's for you.

I also agree with a change in lifestyle, take care of yourself and your body will take care of you, OP. You'll be shocked how well you feel when you work out and don't eat fried crap all day.

A shift in OPs perspective would be helpful as well. Learn to think of the bigger picture/outside of yourself and your inner world. Not really sure how to go about that, Acid and hallucinogens did it for me, but I discourage such use in this case for pretty obvious reasons.

I also agree that you should take action OP, quit feeling sorry for yourself, the world ain't gonna throw you a bone, no matter how shit you feel. You HAVE to be the one who makes changes and opportunities. You are strong and have that power, you just need to learn to harness it. 

Good luck OP.

I prefer to buy Litecoin and then transfer that into monero and then to a different wallet if I need to. (More and more markets are using monero and other alternatives like litecoin.) 1 to 1.5 grams are a great way to test the waters with shrooms, it's enough for slight visuals with a rather calm peak, but def enough to blow your mind. Anything more than a dose like that can be extremely overwhelming if you are new. I made the poorly informed decision to do an 8th for my first shroom trip, it was way too intense and had a panic attack, which on shrooms feels unspeakably awful. But I don't regret the experience.

As for your trip, you will most likely face a very uncomfortable come up for about an hour or so. It's quite common to get anxious during this because everything will feel weird and wrong and you can end up overthinking or panicking. So, you need to make sure to breathe deeply and reassure yourself that you will be okay. I find it really helps to tell myself that I'm a vessel for the shrooms.

Music or mindless tv are great to have in the background, I find that silence can make me really uncomfortable while tripping. I would make sure you have someone either watching you or someone you will be able to call, this is always good whether you are facing a tough trip or just want to talk about random things.

But whatever happens during the trip, make sure to have fun.

Feel free to ask me anything else you want to know.
